title: AIR CONDITIONING-PLENUM PANELS
summary: Air-conditioned cars (C60): fiberglass panels at the cowl plenum (the air intake area under the cowl/windshield, behind the front fenders). The center plenum filler panel is bonded in, a tapping plate is riveted to it, and LH/RH covers plus a vent-hole cover close off openings in the plenum side area; covers are bonded (bond "K").

fastening.to: plenum side panel, strip-lower outer W/S bonding and dash panel
fastening.note: Center plenum filler [1] is bonded (bond "B") at its upper end to the plenum side panel and at its lower flange; bond spec not in a legend on this sheet.

fastening.to: plenum panel below the front fender (the panel with two holes and a slot)
fastening.note: Tapping plate [2] is riveted on with rivets [3] (main view), over the holes and slot in the plenum panel; it gives a threaded anchor for a fastener from another sheet.
Covers [4] are bonded in with bond "K" (main view and View A, LH side).

fastening.to: body side panel, LH side (View A)
fastening.note: View A: vent-hole cover [5] sits over a hole in the side panel; no fastener or bond tag shown for it.

notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch wipes the 4th and 5th digits; visible "396" + "42".
Bond "B"/"K" are bonding codes with no legend on this sheet; recorded in fastening notes, not materials.
Item 5 attachment not shown; assumed it simply covers the hole (how=seals).
Revision block has 5 blank triangle symbols and no entries.
